issues.explanation: name/slug/targetMembershipId have no #[Validate] attributes; validation is declared via protected rules() instead of the project's #[Validate] + $this->validate() pattern.
Status is server-set output rendered to the same user, but as a writable public property the client can overwrite it; it should be locked/protected or computed.
AssignRole action throws InvalidArgumentException for a non-manageable role (500 on direct use) instead of a validation error on role; the Livewire caller validates first so the user path is correct.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes via app/Actions/* with Gate authorize inside (AddMember.php:38, AssignRole.php:74, TransferOwnership.php:202); policies used everywhere; #[Fillable] on models; Bulma + x-form-field/x-button; docs updated (docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md). Deviation: Settings.php:41-45 public name/slug/targetMembershipId lack #[Validate] and use protected rules():502-515 instead of #[Validate].

readability.evidence: app/Actions/TransferOwnership.php:200-217 small atomic handle; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:15-42 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:44-79 clear names; no dead code or debug output in blades/components.

requirements.evidence: entities slug unique entities_slug_unique + SoftDeletes + getRouteKeyName slug (Entity.php:46); entity_memberships FK cascade + owner_seq storedAs + uniques (migration 054633:1002-1007); policies EntityPolicy.php:8-42 and MembershipPolicy view/assignRole/delete; pick controller session+audit+redirect (EntityPickController.php:27-30); Dashboard/Members/Settings mount authorize + Locked entity; routes/web.php:1372-1375; lang en/pt_BR nav_members/nav_settings/owner notice/transfer title present.

scope.evidence: Diff adds only entities/memberships model, policies, actions, pick controller, 3 Livewire pages + blades, 4 routes, lang keys, 2 migrations, docs/CHANGELOG, and entity tests; no onboarding/switcher/middleware/navbar/queues/billing/restore changes.

security.evidence: All mounts authorize (Dashboard.php:13 view, Members.php:363 view, Settings.php:449 manageSettings); every action authorizes (Members.php:370,390,403; Settings.php:458,472,485) with scoped findOrFail (Members.php:388,401); inputs validated (Members.php:356 email exists, 392 Rule::in manageable; Settings.php:504-513 unique ignore); entity #[Locked]; blades use {{ }} only; audit channel used.

simplicity.evidence: One Action per use case (AddMember/AssignRole/RemoveMember/UpdateEntity/DeleteEntity/TransferOwnership); no service layers; reads stay as Eloquent in components; demote-before-promote inline in one transaction (TransferOwnership.php:212-214).

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/DashboardTest.php non-member 403 + session-spoof 403 + guest/unverified; MembersTest.php employee 403 on add/assign, owner-role validation error, foreign-id ModelNotFound, last-manager 403, rate-limit; SettingsTest.php admin/employee 403, locked-swap tamper, demoted-owner 403, transfer to employee/self/foreign/null 403 + audit; EntityDataModelTest second-owner DB rejection; PickEntityTest session untouched on 403.

review.summary: Implements the full entity data model, policies, pick flow, and dashboard/members/settings pages with atomic ownership transfer and thorough Pest coverage. Authorization, validation, locking, and docs all follow the project standards apart from minor nits. Approve with nits.
